# Independent audit: one-face outer-envelope payment

Audited source: `candidate 696a6484b3fda438`, §§1--6.



The finite-base support majorant at a relative-interior source witness extends the marked homothetic envelope globally. Full base rank is essential to identify the affine support majorant uniquely; widths then force positive ell on every positive-volume fiber, and hence throughout the convex base hull. The common-boundary area formula and ell^(-1) weighted contact formula follow from homothetic surface scaling; they do not identify the older volume-row law with a boundary law.

The activity propagation requires an interior active witness or an interior positive combination of active witnesses. Mere boundary-source activity is insufficient. The NEW cover meets the stronger hypothesis precisely when its full deepest hull is occupied: see `candidate 8effe5eb4947ba88`, the maximal-occupied-face construction and full-face contact equality. Parameter-plane reduction alone supplies no such fact.

The normal-dependent exponential of the affine nonnegative support gap is an allowed globally convex test. Dominated convergence restricts the same stress and allocations to actual outer contacts. Every selected proper cap plane has zero H_(d-1) measure on the entire boundary of D, even without strict convexity: its boundary intersection lies in the relative boundary of the full-dimensional plane section. In d=1 the cut is interior and cannot be an endpoint. Thus the literal supporting allocations do disappear on these particular contacts. Strict convexity is used only to make the pointed contact position uniquely determined by the normal. The contact normal measure dominates a positive scaled copy of S_D and is also absolutely continuous with respect to it, giving the claimed almost-everywhere bound.

For P=1+a·xi, the projective Jacobian is P^(-d-1); the energy derivative has exponent -d-2 and implies that the image centroid is zero. The surface cone density h_D(n)P^(-d) has total mass d E_D(0). Through-zero cone fractions equal projective volume fractions, and every buffered pointed cap contains its parallel through-zero cap. This proves the exact Gamma_d credit, including d=1. Since every omitted term in the H response is nonnegative, the exact conclusion is beta+(d+2)Delta/(2dM)>=Gamma_d.

For nonsmooth exposed faces the perspective localization is valid, but it yields only conditional convex-test inequalities against the actual ell-weighted contact footprints. The note correctly stops before any unproved uniform-face or centroid payment. No limit of strict-convex bodies is asserted to preserve the attained separator or group hypotheses.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
